risks.risk: Rust/staining on the lower front could indicate corrosion, water ingress, or poor maintenance—may affect longevity or cause leaks.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the rust area plus a photo of the bottom edge and door seal; ideally a short leak test after a rinse cycle.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst case: corrosion risk / possible water issue (assume needs inspection).

risks.risk: Unknown working condition (drain/spin/heating) and possible hidden faults (pump, motor, control board).
risks.proof: A video of the machine running a full cycle (wash + spin) with no error codes, plus a photo of any error code if it appears.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst case: not confirmed working (assume may need repair).

risks.risk: Door seal (gasket) condition not fully verifiable from one photo; could be torn or moldy causing leaks/poor washing.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the rubber door gasket all around, and a photo of the inside rim for cracks/tears.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst case: gasket may be worn (assume possible leak/poor performance).

risks.risk: Exact model number not readable; capacity is shown but variant affects parts availability and value.
risks.proof: Photo of the rating/model plate (usually on the door frame or back) showing model number and serial.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the generic worst-case for a used LG 7kg DirectDrive without confirmed exact variant.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the rating/model plate (model number + serial) on the machine.
Send a short video of the machine powering on and running a full cycle (including spin) with no error codes.
Send close-up photos of the door gasket all around and the rust/staining area at the bottom front.
If possible, show a quick drain/spin test (water drains properly; no unusual noise).
response.reason: The photos confirm it’s an LG DirectDrive 7kg, but working condition and the severity of visible lower rust/staining are not verifiable remotely. To price safely for Lagos pickup, we need proof of a running cycle and clearer identification (model plate).
